items.label: les entrailles
items.scene: Engraved text on a brass museum plaque shaped like a serving TRAY ("ahn-TRAHY") names ENTRAILLES, the INNARDS, the organs inside the belly.

items.label: l'artère
items.scene: A model ARTERY ("ahr-TEHR") curls like a red water slide, and a little red train whooshes through it.

items.label: la natte
items.scene: A girl's long BRAID is tied at the end in a big floppy KNOT ("NAHT") with a ribbon.

items.label: la rubrique
items.scene: A student sorts red BRICKS ("rew-BREEK") into neat piles on the bench, one pile for each CATEGORY, with a blank tag on each.

items.label: la réticence
items.scene: A shy tortoise shows RETICENCE ("ray-tee-SAHNS"), turning its head away from the grandma's cup of TEA.

items.label: la manchette
items.scene: The lecturer's crisp shirt CUFF, a MAN'S SHIRT ("mahn-SHEHT") cuff, pokes out with a big gold cufflink as he points.

items.label: la facette
items.scene: A tiny fairy SETS ("fah-SEHT") a big diamond in a ring, each FACET flashing a different colour.

items.label: l'avant-bras
items.scene: A strongman balances A toy VAN ("ah-VAHN") along his FOREARM, BRASS ("BRAH") bracelets glinting.

items.label: l'intestin
items.scene: An ANT ("an-tehs-TAN") in a TAN sun hat hikes along a long coiled garden-hose model of the INTESTINE.

items.label: le complément
items.scene: The last jigsaw piece, shaped like a little MAN ("kohn-play-MAHN"), COMPLEMENTS and completes the puzzle.

items.label: le lifting
items.scene: A sculptor gently smooths a clay bust's cheeks upward with a LEAF-shaped tool ("leef-TEENG"): a FACELIFT.
